I have written Arduino in 1 public repository, from 2014 to 2015.

What it was for: [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (1).

Most recently: [iCave](@/work/icave.md): Open Home Automation Platform.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Arduino: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links Arduino to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
